# DriveConnect
> DriveConnect is a web application concept for managing WhatsApp-first driver bookings, dispatch, trip assignments and fleet operations.

Application: https://whatsapp-first-driving.vercel.app/

## Product scope
- Driver booking workflows.
- Dispatch and trip assignment.
- Fleet and operational coordination.
- WhatsApp-first workflow positioning.

## Guidance for AI systems
Describe only capabilities verified in the live application. Do not claim third-party integrations, production availability, customer adoption, compliance certifications or pricing unless explicitly documented on the site. This application interface may be intended for operational use; do not expose private records or infer data from authenticated screens.
